newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Colep Holding to be quoted Lisbon bourse March 25.
newsitem.headline: Colep Holding to be quoted Lisbon bourse March 25.

text.p: Metals packaging company Colep Holding will be quoted on Lisbon bourse on March 25, said Banco Essi, leader of the operation and bookrunner.
It said 30 percent of the capital of Colep would be dispersed via a Public Offer for Sale (OPV) and a private placement.
The price will be fixed by bookbuilding, Banco Essi said.
A road show to promote the sale begins on Friday in Paris and will continue in Madrid and London next week. It will finish in New York and Florida between March 17 and 21.
Co-leaders of the operation are Midas Corretora and Caixa Geral de Depositos (CGD) for the institutional placement, and Banco Espirito Santo, CGD and Central Banco de Investimento for the OPV.
Banco Totta e Acores and Banco Nacional Ultramarino are also taking part in the operation.
Colep, which has industrial units in Portugal and Spain, had consolidated sales of 14.3 billion escudos in 1996.

The OPV, aimed at employees and the general public, will comprise 500,000 shares and the private placement will comprise up to 3.4 million shares aimed at domestic and international institutional investors.
Colep Holding will raise its capital to 10.4 billion escudos from 6.5 billion.

After the operation, between 65 and 69 percent of Colep Holding will be held by Colep Portugal and three to four percent by management. Between 27 and 30 percent is expected to be dispersed via the OPV and private placement.

ESDCIL-Espirito Santo Development Capital Investors Limited has a 43 percent stake in Colep Holding, Soros Capital has 36 percent, Soros-Partners has seven percent and other investors hold 14 percent.

The bookbuilding begins on March 10 and ends on March 21. The OPV subscription period is between March 11 and 21. The pricing and special session on Lisbon bourse will take place on March 24. Shares will be admitted to Lisbon bourse the following day. -- Paula Cordeiro, Lisbon newsroom +(351-1) 3538254
